name: Hallmaster
shortDescription: A UK cloud booking, invoicing and payment-tracking system for church halls and other bookable venues, operated by Hallmaster Ltd.
suitableContexts: Churches hiring out a church hall or multiple rooms to the public
Volunteer booking teams needing online requests, invoices and payment tracking
Venues requiring a public availability calendar embedded in their website

pricing.summary: Hallmaster publishes annual UK prices including VAT: £195 for Booking System Only and £279 for Booking & Invoicing. It also promotes a 90-day free trial. Check payment-provider charges, integrations, optional modules and renewal terms before purchase.

tiers.label: Booking System Only
tiers.detail: Unlimited rooms and bookings, real-time availability calendar, website integration and telephone and email support

tiers.label: Booking & Invoicing System
tiers.detail: Booking features plus invoices, reports and bulk monthly invoice generation

pricing.trialDetails: Supplier promotes a 90-day free trial with full support and no commitment.

gdprInformation: Hallmaster's privacy policy says it is controller for its own customer data and processor where it holds venue-user and booking data on a customer's behalf. The policy and supplier articles refer to UK GDPR, data ownership and daily backups. Obtain the current SaaS terms, DPA, hosting location, sub-processors, retention, recovery and breach arrangements before uploading booking data.
coreFeatures: Online church-hall and room booking requests
PDF invoices and bulk monthly invoices
Venue hire-agreement links in booking forms
importExport: Import Hallmaster invoices into accounting software
support: Telephone and email support on the published Booking System Only package
Supplier publishes Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm contact hours
90-day trial with full support stated by supplier

uk-operator.value: Hallmaster Ltd is an active private limited company registered in England and Wales under number 10747910.

church-hall-scope.value: Supplier publishes a church-hall booking page covering online availability, multiple rooms, invoices and payment tracking.

pricing-and-trial.value: Supplier publishes £195 and £279 annual packages including VAT and a 90-day free trial.

data-processing.value: Supplier privacy policy identifies Hallmaster as processor for hall-user and booking data held on a customer's behalf.

editorial.assessment: Hallmaster is a strong UK option where the task is hiring out a church hall rather than scheduling internal ministry rooms. Its booking calendar, customer requests, invoicing, payment tracking and website embedding are designed around public venue hire, including multi-room sites. The public price is unusually clear for this category. A church should still assess the live SaaS and data-processing pack, payment flows and the practical workflow for deposits, cancellations, refunds and its own hire agreement.
bestFor: Church halls with public or community lettings
Teams needing booking, invoicing and payment tracking in one system
Churches wanting a public booking calendar integrated into their existing website
strengths: Active named UK company with a public company number
Church-hall-specific service page and GBP annual prices including VAT
Booking, invoicing, payment tracking and website integration in one product
limitations: It is primarily for public venue hire, not internal rota or ministry-room scheduling
Confirm payment-provider fees, deposits, refunds and cancellation handling
Obtain current SaaS, DPA, hosting, sub-processor, retention, recovery and exit documentation
Accounting integrations and optional building-control features require workflow and cost checks

procurementVerdict.problem: Managing church-hall bookings, invoices and availability without spreadsheets or duplicated calendars
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK cloud venue-hire system with church-hall-specific workflows and published annual GBP prices
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Use the trial to model a real hire, deposit or invoice, cancellation and website booking request; then review the current data-processing and payment terms

externalReviews.note: This company-level profile is for Hallmaster and does not establish suitability for a particular church.
